about_the_game:
Time Takers is a fast-paced, third-person team-based survival shooter where time itself is the ultimate resource — and every decision can change the outcome in seconds. 

 

Drop into intense battle zones where momentum shifts in an instant. Collect Time Energy, upgrade abilities mid-match, extend survival in critical moments by sharing your lifespan with teammates, or spend everything in a desperate final push. Victory isn’t just about aim — it’s about knowing when to act, when to hold back, and when to risk it all. 

 

High-Speed Survival, Built for Teamplay 

Matches are short, high-intensity, and constantly evolving. There’s no downtime — only movement, pressure, and split-second judgment. 

  • Constant engagement and high mobility 

  • Tactical positioning and character synergy 

  • Moment-to-moment decisions that define the match 

 

Phase-Based Match Progression 

Each match progresses through a total of 7 phases. As phases advance, available Time Energy decreases while overall survival pressure increases. It forces teams into more frequent and intense engagements.  

 

Break Free from Fixed Roles 

Unlike traditional hero shooters, Time Takers doesn’t lock you into rigid playstyles. 

Each character brings a unique core ability, but your choice of weapons and passive apps defines how you play. Adapt your build mid-match, respond to enemy tactics, and reshape your role as the situation demands — even with the same character. 

 
Built for Coordination and Comebacks 

You’re never fighting alone. Team composition, timing, and coordination can turn a losing battle into a last-second victory. 

In Time Takers, you fight as a team. Team composition, resource sharing, and efficient route planning can turn even disadvantageous situations into victory.  

  • Share Time Energy to support allies 

  • Control the pace together or fall apart alone 

 

Collect. Spend. Share. Survive. 

Every second counts!

short_description: Every second alive is a second you can spend. Time is your health, your power, and your last resort. Pick a Traveler from across time, build your loadout, outlast every squad. No fixed roles. Adapt or run out of Time. 3v3 survival shooter. Free to play.
